stride.description: Org adopts a SaaS mobile app used on personal/BYOD devices (no MDM). Users authenticate via SAML + MFA. The SaaS app holds no personal or sensitive data. Corporate policy forbids personal devices connecting/authenticating to the corporate environment (e.g. Entra ID).

bowtie.threat_name: Unmanaged BYOD obtains corporate SAML SSO session
consequences: Corporate policy breach (personal device on Entra ID)
IdP foothold enabling lateral movement to managed resources
Token reuse if session not device-bound
preventive_barriers: Conditional Access: block non-compliant / unmanaged devices
Session binding / device fingerprint on SAML assertion
Separate SaaS tenant (no Entra ID SSO) to avoid IdP exposure
escalation_factors: Rogue CA rule allowing unmanaged join

risk_register.name: Policy breach: unmanaged personal device authenticates to Entra ID (SAML SSO)
vulnerabilities: SAML IdP accepts any enrolled user device

risk_register.name: MFA fatigue / push-bombing on SAML login
Stolen/unlocked personal device yields SAML session
vulnerabilities: No device lock binding on assertion
No conditional access on device state

risk_register.name: SAML token replay / session not device-bound
vulnerabilities: Assertion not bound to device fingerprint

risk_register.name: IdP foothold → lateral movement to managed corporate resources
vulnerabilities: Shared Entra ID tenant between SaaS and corporate

risk_register.name: Audit/assurance failure: non-compliant auth path undetected
vulnerabilities: No CA policy logging on unmanaged join

risk_register.name: Rogue Conditional Access rule permits unmanaged join

recommendations.RSK-0001: Decouple the SaaS app from corporate SSO: provision a SEPARATE non-Entra identity (own IdP/tenant) so personal devices never authenticate to Entra ID. If SSO mandatory, enforce Conditional Access blocking unmanaged devices (AC, CM) + MDM enrolment.
recommendations.RSK-0002: Adopt phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/number-matching), cap prompts, risk-based step-up; disable pure push notifications (IA, AC).
recommendations.RSK-0003: Bind SAML assertion to device posture check; require managed/registered device or deny; combine with MFA (IA, AC, SC).
recommendations.RSK-0004: Issue short-lived, device-bound tokens; enable SAML assertion encryption + audience restriction; rotate sessions on privilege change (SC, SI, CM).
recommendations.RSK-0005: Separate SaaS tenant from corporate Entra ID; least-privilege SSO app roles; scope token audience to SaaS only (AC, CM).
recommendations.RSK-0006: Log/alert unmanaged-device Entra ID sign-ins; CA compliance reporting to SIEM; periodic access reviews (AU, SC, IA).
recommendations.RSK-0007: Restrict CA administration; change approval + break-glass; monitor CA rule drift (AC, CM, AU).

scope: BYOD SaaS mobile app, SAML+MFA auth to Entra ID, no MDM, no PII on app, policy forbids personal devices on corporate env
